test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: In context, the phrase "top-down regulations" most nearly means:
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2) Policies imposed by higher authorities**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"regulations"** means official rules or directives made and maintained by an authority. (नियमावली) • **Example: **The government has strict regulations regarding wildlife protection. • **"Top-down" **refers to an approach where decisions and rules are created by higher authorities and passed down to lower levels without involving them in the decision-making. (ऊपरी स्तर से नीचे लागू किया गया) • **Example: **The company followed a top-down strategy where managers dictated every step to employees. • Hence, **"top-down regulations"** means **"policies imposed by higher authorities"**. (उच्च अधिकारियों द्वारा थोपे गए नियम) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2) Policies imposed by higher authorities**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Rules created by local villagers **(स्थानीय ग्रामीणों द्वारा बनाए गए नियम): These are community-based rules made by the villagers themselves. • **Example:** The local villagers created their own rules to prevent overgrazing in the forest. • **Option 3: Guidelines developed by scientists **(वैज्ञानिकों द्वारा विकसित दिशा-निर्देश): Refers to instructions or frameworks created by experts for conservation or research purposes. • **Example:** Scientists developed guidelines for sustainable fishing practices. • **Option 4: Suggestions from tourists **(पर्यटकों से सुझाव): Refers to opinions or advice given by tourists, which are not official rules. • **Example:** Tourists suggested building more eco-friendly lodges in the sanctuary. 36:Tc83, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
